results.fact: 2026 fire closure of the Cathedral Pass Trail / trailhead
results.correct_value: The Three Queens Fire closure (Aug 11 - Oct 31, 2026) included the Cathedral Pass, Peggy's Pond and Deception Pass trails; the Sept 18 reduction dropped Cathedral Pass and Peggy's Pond but kept the PCT (Ridge Lake to Lake Vicente) and the Deception Pass trail closed.
results.evidence: A KOMO news report (Aug 12-13, 2026) lists the closed trails, including Cathedral Pass Trail 1345, Peggy's Pond Trail 1375 and Deception Pass Trail 1376, with the closure running through Oct 31, 2026. The Forest Service order (effective Aug 11 through Oct 31, 2026) was reduced on Sept 18, 2026. Its revised list no longer includes 1345 or 1375, but it still includes the PCT from Ridge Lake to Lake Vicente, which crosses Cathedral Pass, and the Deception Pass trail. The Cathedral Pass trail page still carries the closure alert. access.closures ('no route-specific closures as of mid-2026') was stale.

The Pacific Crest Trail from Ridge Lake to the Lake Vicente trail, which runs through Cathedral Pass, and the Deception Pass trail stayed closed. Confirm the current order with the Cle Elum Ranger District before a trip.

results.fact: Whether the Northwest Couloir is the standard descent after climbing the Northeast Buttress
results.correct_value: The standard descent from the summit is the Southwest Face/south side; the Northwest Couloir is only an occasional descent back toward Peggy's Pond.
results.evidence: The Mountaineers Southwest Face page describes the descent as a double-rope rappel from the top of the last pitch and downclimbing the climbing route, with an east-gully alternative. The standard route's own descent_text calls the couloir a minority variation. The couloir row's 'standard descent' and 'frequently used after the Northeast Buttress' claims have no support.
